original: Some of the highest peaks of the mountain complex are Bruncu Spina (1,828 meters), Punta Florisa (1,822 meters), Punta Paolina (1,792 meters), Punta Erba Irdes (1,703 meters), Bruncu Allasu (1,701 meters), Monte Iscudu (1,676 meters) and Monte Spada (1,595 meters).
translated: Einige der höchsten Gipfel des Bergkomplexes sind Bruncu Spina (1.828 Meter), Punta Florisa (1.822 Meter), Punta Paolina (1.792 Meter), Punta Erba Irdes (1.703 Meter), Bruncu Allasu (1.701 Meter), Monte Iscudu (1.676 Meter) und Monte Spada (1.595 Meter).
